$comment: Daedalus runs fully local — FastAPI + SQLite + Ollama in Docker, never deployed.
The Vercel plugin's hooks were matching on incidental words ('deploy', 'ppr',
'retry', 'student', even 'purpple') and injecting Next.js/Vercel guidance that
does not apply to a Vite + FastAPI project. Disabled here only: several other
projects on this machine are genuinely Next.js and still want it, so the
user-level setting in ~/.claude/settings.json is deliberately left alone.
